# OrganizationMember

`sentry.kube.nas1k.dev/v1alpha1` · Namespaced · [all resources](../README.md)

## Example

```yaml
apiVersion: sentry.kube.nas1k.dev/v1alpha1
kind: OrganizationMember
metadata:
  name: example
spec:
  forProvider:
    email: <email>
    organizationRef:
      name: <name>
```

## Spec

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `deletionPolicy` | string |  | `Orphan` keeps the external resource when the managed resource is deleted. Without `Delete` in `managementPolicies` the resource is always orphaned. One of `Delete`, `Orphan`. Default `Delete`. |
| `forProvider` | object | yes | `spec.forProvider`: the generated API fields plus references and credentials. |
| `forProvider.email` | string | yes | The email address to send the invitation to. |
| `forProvider.orgRole` | string |  | The organization-level role of the new member. Roles include: * `billing` - Can manage payment and compliance details. * `member` - Can view and act on events, as well as view most other data within the organization. * `manager` - Has full management access to all teams and projects. Can also manage the organization's membership. * `owner` - Has unrestricted access to the organization, its data, and its settings. Can add, modify, and delete projects and members, as well as make billing and plan changes. * `admin` - Can edit global integrations, manage projects, and add/remove teams. They automatically assume the Team Admin role for teams they join. Note: This role can no longer be assigned in Business and Enterprise plans. Use `TeamRoles` instead. One of `billing`, `member`, `manager`, `owner`, `admin`. Default `member`. |
| `forProvider.organizationRef` | object |  | A reference to an object of kind `Organization` (default) in the namespace of the resource holding the reference, or of kind `ClusterOrganization`, by `kind`. |
| `forProvider.organizationRef.apiVersion` | string |  | `apiVersion` of the referenced object; needed when its kind is in several groups. |
| `forProvider.organizationRef.kind` | string |  | One of `Organization`, `ClusterOrganization`. Default `Organization`. |
| `forProvider.organizationRef.name` | string | yes |  |
| `forProvider.regenerate` | boolean |  | Reissue the invite token, invalidating any previously sent invite link. |
| `forProvider.reinvite` | boolean |  | Whether or not to re-invite a user who has already been invited to the organization. Defaults to True. |
| `forProvider.role` | string |  | Deprecated, use `orgRole`. The organization-level role to assign. * `member` - Member * `admin` - Admin * `manager` - Manager * `owner` - Owner One of `member`, `admin`, `manager`, `owner`. Default `member`. |
| `forProvider.sendInvite` | boolean |  | Whether or not to send an invite notification through email. Defaults to True. Default `true`. |
| `forProvider.teamRoles` | []map[string]any |  | The team and team-roles assigned to the member. Team roles can be either: - `contributor` - Can view and act on issues. Depending on organization settings, they can also add team members. - `admin` - Has full management access to their team's membership and projects. |
| `forProvider.teams` | []any |  | Deprecated, use `teamRoles`. Slugs of teams to add the member to. |
| `managementPolicies` | []string |  | Actions the controller may take. `["*"]` (default) allows all; `["Observe"]` only reads (import without management). `Observe` is always required. Default `["*"]`. |
